rule: owner cost rule 2026-10-06: face stages per face N = clamp(ceil(d / 380 um), 2, 5), d = in-view core endpoint <-> pin wire (max over the port bits); every boundary still reg-to-reg (pin flop); face chains spaced evenly by face_chain_place.tcl
baseline: face_stages 5 on every face (s17..s19): in-view latency of a core path = 5 in + 5 out, pass-through 10

hfd_quant.latency: f_vm in 2 -> actquant_m -> t_su out 3 (NE/SE) / 4 (NW/SW): in-view 5-6 vs 10 (-4 / -5 cycles on the VM -> quant -> SU path)

hfd_coll.latency: f_su in 4, t_su out 4, llk 2-3, cmdproc 3: core paths 6-8 vs 10

hfd_vm.latency: f_su in 4 (NE/NW) / 5 (SE/SW), i* in 4; outputs t_quant 3, t_router 4, q* 3, x* 3, t_su 4-5: f_su_NE -> t_quant 7 vs 10 (-3)

hfd_cmdproc_n.latency: cycle cost vs hfd_cmdproc (face_stages 5 everywhere): cpS core path in 3 + out 3 = 6 (-4); cpN in 4 (xl: S pin flop + 2 + N pin flop; cN* 4) + out 3 = 7 (-3); f_barrier[0:16] -> S faces 2+2+2+3 = 9 (-1), [16:32] -> N faces 2+3 = 5 (-5); t_barrier[0:16] 3+2+1+3 = 9 (-1), [16:32] 4+3 = 7 (-3)
